While mounting / removing the modules:
• Make sure that each terminal block is still connected to the shield bar.
• Disconnect voltage supplying sensors and pre-actuators.
Failure to follow these instructions will result in death or serious injury.
notes: Safety-relevant: rack power to the module does NOT need to be removed (p.18, modules can be installed/removed without turning off rack power); what must be locked out/disconnected is the field-side voltage to sensors/pre-actuators, while keeping the terminal block connected to the shield bar.
